ios.desc:
Take your customer conversations and video outreach on the move.

Your prospects and customers don’t want to wait. With Drift, it’s easy to connect with them, now.

- Never miss an important conversation - chat live with your customers and leads anywhere, anytime.
- Record and share personalized videos when you’re away from your desk.
- Get notified immediately and start conversations when a key account visits your website or when an important prospect views your video.
- Automatically schedule meetings from live chat while your customer is engaged.
- See all your recorded videos and chat history in one place.

DRIFT VIDEO:

Record quick personalized videos on the go.
Easily share videos via email, social, or messaging apps.
Track views & get notified on your phone.
Chat live while customers watch your video.
100% free to use.

DRIFT CHAT:

Talk to your customers, anywhere, anytime.
Track conversations & get notified on your phone.
Drop your calendar to automatically book meetings. 
See all your contact details and conversation history.
Filter for the conversations that matter most.
Assign participants, manage tags, and add notes.

ABOUT DRIFT:

Drift is the Conversational Marketing platform that combines chat, email, video, and automation to remove the friction from business buying. With Drift, you can start conversations with future customers now, on their terms – not days later. There are over 50,000 businesses that use Drift today to generate more revenue, shrink sales cycles, and make buying easy. Our mission is to use conversations to make business buying frictionless, more enjoyable and more human.

quotes.text: FYI, we have a mobile app https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/drift-messaging-for-sales/id1117096112?mt=8 and a two-way Slack integration at Drift. http://www.drift.com/
